text: {"opportunities":[{"name":"GitHub developer lead research and email draft","description":"Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com with follower count, top repo stats and latest post for a given role.","site":"github","steps":["Click GitHub search and type the username, press Enter","Click the 'Users' results filter","Open the matching user profile","Open the top repository and note stars and language","Open mail compose, fill To with hiring@example.com","Set Subject 'Lead for <role>: <username>'","Type body with followers, top repo (stars, language) and latest post","Discard the draft"],"parameters":["github username","role title","follower count","top repo","stars/language","latest post title"],"confidence":0.9,"instances":[{"start_t":108.3,"end_t":311.6,"values":"karpathy, ML Research Engineer, nanoGPT"},{"start_t":474.8,"end_t":540.6,"values":"gaearon, Staff Frontend Engineer, react/react"},{"start_t":737.5,"end_t":817.7,"values":"simonw, Developer Advocate, llm"}]},{"name":"Wikipedia person + Wayback Machine snapshot note","description":"Look up a person on Wikipedia, view an archived snapshot of a related domain's homepage for a given year, and save a combined note.","site":"wikipedia / archive.org / notes","steps":["Search the person's name on Wikipedia and read key facts","Open Wayback Machine and enter the domain","Select the year and a snapshot date","Read the homepage headline, return","Open Notes, create a new note with the person's facts and the domain's year headline"],"parameters":["person name","domain","year","snapshot link"],"confidence":0.85,"instances":[{"start_t":323.9,"end_t":449.7,"values":"Satya Nadella, microsoft.com, 2014"},{"start_t":554.9,"end_t":724.6,"values":"Jacinda Ardern, nasa.gov, 2019"},{"start_t":870.7,"end_t":940.8,"values":"Tim Berners-Lee, w3.org, 2005"}]}]}

opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com with follower count, top repo stats and latest post for a given role.
steps: Click GitHub search and type the username, press Enter
Open the top repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose, fill To with hiring@example.com
Type body with followers, top repo (stars, language) and latest post

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person + Wayback Machine snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view an archived snapshot of a related domain's homepage for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia and read key facts
Open Wayback Machine and enter the domain
Select the year and a snapshot date
Open Notes, create a new note with the person's facts and the domain's year headline
